title: Nvidia is financing its own customer
angle: When the chip supplier guarantees the buyer's credit, the order book and the loan book are the same book.

frames.text: Nvidia is guaranteeing $105B so OpenAI can buy Nvidia chips.
Financing Nvidia is guaranteeing for one OpenAI data center in Ohio.
Capacity OpenAI contracted there. First 800MW comes online in 2028.
OpenAI agreed to use Nvidia chips exclusively at the campus.
SoftBank's SB Energy builds it. OpenAI leases it for 20 years.
The order book and the loan book are now the same book.
